headline: Privileged ops account bulk-exported 212 KYC files off-hours and sent them to an external share
summary: SAMPLE. An operations admin assumed the KYC-Emergency role at 23:40 from a new device and a second city, then downloaded 212 KYC files in 15 minutes, 106 times the usual rate. The files were uploaded to a destination that is not on the allowlist. 198 customers are affected.
why_unusual: Emergency role assumed with no covering approval
New device and a second city within one hour

rules_affected.why: Reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach (verify clause).
Report cyber incidents within 6 hours (verify clause).

root_cause_hypotheses: Insider misuse of the emergency role
recommended_actions: Keep sessions revoked and bucket deny in place
Prepare RBI and CERT-In reports before the 6 h timers
confidence_reason: Five independent signals agree and the volume is far outside baseline.
